name: Suspicious WSMAN Provider Image Loads
description: Detects signs of potential use of the WSMAN provider from uncommon processes locally and remote execution.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (((file.path:(*\\WsmSvc.dll OR *\\WsmAuto.dll OR *\\Microsoft.WSMan.Management.ni.dll)) OR (file.pe.original_file_name:(WsmSvc.dll OR WSMANAUTOMATION.DLL OR Microsoft.WSMan.Management.dll))) OR (process.executable:*\\svchost.exe AND file.pe.original_file_name:WsmWmiPl.dll)) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\System32\\sdiagnhost.exe OR *C\:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe)) OR (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:(*svchost.exe\ \-k\ netsvcs\ \-p\ \-s\ BITS* OR *svchost.exe\ \-k\ GraphicsPerfSvcGroup\ \-s\ GraphicsPerfSvc* OR *svchost.exe\ \-k\ NetworkService\ \-p\ \-s\ Wecsvc* OR *svchost.exe\ \-k\ netsvcs*)) OR ((process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\v* OR C\:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\v*)) AND process.executable:*\\mscorsvw.exe) OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Configure\-SMRemoting.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\ServerManager.exe)) OR process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\asgard2\-agent\\* OR process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\Citrix\\* OR process.executable:*\\powershell_ise.exe OR process.executable:C\:\\$WINDOWS.\~BT\\Sources\\*)) AND (NOT (process.executable:*\\svchost.exe AND (NOT _exists_:winlog.event_data.CommandLine)))
